description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Minsc, adding {C}{C}.
When Minsc dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Minsc from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Minsc enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Boo legendary creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
